Q6111.reason: Dumping trash can be expressive conduct, but a content-neutral littering ban serving a legitimate interest survives O'Brien scrutiny; the team note is wrong that only words are protected.

Q5735.reason: Under 28 U.S.C. § 1441(a) only the defendant may remove, so the plaintiff's removal is improper and the whole case is remanded; the team note's claim that plaintiffs may remove is incorrect.

Q5651.reason: The advertised model year is an express affirmation or description of the goods that a generic 'as is' clause cannot fully negate, so the disclaimer is not totally effective; the team note's fault requirement is wrong because express warranty liability does not depend on negligence.
